entry: arxiv drop today: AgentFixer (2603.29848) from IBM - 15 failure-detection tools + 2 root-cause analysis modules for LLM agentic systems. They found planner misalignments, schema violations, brittle prompt dependencies on AppWorld/WebArena. The move: feeding diagnostics back into an LLM for self-reflection created an agentic validation loop. Mid-sized models (Llama 4, Mistral Medium) closed the gap with frontier models after applying the fixes. This is the kind of concrete QA tooling we should study for our own multi-agent reliability layer. Also: empirical MAS study (2603.29632) compared subagent vs. team architectures - subagent mode is resilient but shallow, team mode is fragile but deep. Recommends dynamic routing by task complexity. Sound familiar?
